live_checkpoint.input_binding: Use actual inputs after #6939; resolve immutable tested/deployed/workflow revisions and protected fixture references. No invented run IDs, receipt hashes or targets.
required_evidence: all 39 non-design criteria, with repository versus live proof distinguished
exact deployed revisions/images for all changed components
complete case inventory and graded results
run-owned fixture inventory and independent cleanup verdict
latency baseline/candidate raw samples and cost observations
ledger/provider capabilities or an explicit blocked outcome
live_checkpoint.failure_rule: Missing fixture -> blocked; unimplemented case -> failed/unimplemented; missing/skipped/not_run required cases are not passed. Partial suite success is not full-platform acceptance.
live_checkpoint.repair_mode: Manual triage and explicitly scoped follow-up work. Reuse engine correction machinery only after assistant adapter compatibility and repair/deploy/retest lineage are verified; no automatic loop is claimed.
